Impact on Instagram: "Only three women have ever been nominated for Best Cinematography in #Oscars history.

Congratulations to Autumn Durald Arkapaw of “Sinners” for making history as the first woman to ever win the category. 🌟

**Edit: The tag should be labeled as “Oscars 2026,” not “Super Bowl 2026.”"
content.text: Only three women have ever been nominated for Best Cinematography in #Oscars history.Congratulations to Autumn Durald Arkapaw of “Sinners” for making history as the first woman to ever win the category. 🌟**Edit: The tag should be labeled as “Oscars 2026,” not “Super Bowl 2026.”When she asked all women in the room to stand up 😭🥹😭🥹 DESERVED !!!!Am I the only one who also stood up when she asked all the women to stand🥺Ryan coogler immediately getting up is making me cryyyyyshe is NOT the first woman to be nominated!!!! she is the first to WIN !!! she specifically mentioned rachel morrison by name bc SHE was the first female cinematographer to be nominated!!!In history? Incredible! She made look Sinners beautiful and powerful. If not for her work, I don't think Ryan's work could have come fully to life. No person deserves this more!Crazy it’s taken this long for a woman to win a category. But nonetheless herstory has been made 👏The way I SCREAMED 👏🏻👏🏻👏🏻Love to see it!!!! & MBJ just won best actor!Love this! She made her Louisiana ancestors proud and the film was filmed here in South Louisiana! Talk about a full circle moment. Well deserve and congratulations!!
